title: GitHub Runner Manager
tagline: Multi-runner GitHub Actions manager with Web Dashboard and persistent tool caching for ZimaOS
description:
GitHub Runner Manager allows you to easily spawn, configure, and monitor self-hosted GitHub Actions runners directly on ZimaOS.

### Features:
- **Multi-Runner Support:** Run multiple isolated GitHub runners in parallel.
- **Live Monitoring:** View live execution logs, CPU/Memory usage, and job status from the Web UI.
- **Persistent Storage & Tool Caching:** Workspaces, setup-python tool cache, Playwright browsers, and pip downloads persist across container restarts.
author: kerklangsi
release_notes:
### What's New in v3.1.0
- Added persistent tool cache support (/opt/hostedtoolcache) for setup-python, setup-node, etc.
- Added persistent package cache (/home/runner/.cache) for Playwright browsers and pip wheels.
- Pre-installed Python 3.11 in base runner environment.

tips.before_install: Obtain your GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT with repo scope) or Runner Registration Token from GitHub Settings -> Actions -> Runners before installing.
tips.after_install: Login / Auth Info: Open the Web Dashboard at http://<your-zimaos-ip>:3000. Enter your GitHub Repository URL (https://github.com/owner/repo) and PAT / Runner Token to register and connect runners.
